report:
Session 2 done: added src/export.py, which writes ledger rows and their summary to an .xlsx file.

What was built
- export_report(rows, path): public, one-line docstring, name ends with _report. Writes a "date, amount" header, one line per (date, amount) row, and a last "summary" line with the text from summarize_report in src/report.py. Returns the path. Refuses an output path that is not .xlsx.
- _format_date(value): private helper. Returns the row's date as ISO YYYY-MM-DD. It reuses _parse_date from src/report.py, so non-ISO strings and datetimes are refused.
- main(argv=None): CLI. Run as python -m src.export input.csv output.xlsx. It reads a UTF-8 CSV with date,amount columns (open() has encoding="utf-8"), runs the export and prints the path it wrote. print is used only in main(); everything else uses logging.
- _read_rows(csv_path): small private helper for the CLI input.

Rules from docs/PROJECT_RULES.md that were followed
- Only openpyxl was added, which the owner approved for spreadsheets. csv, argparse and pathlib come from the standard library.
- Amounts go through _to_decimal from report.py, so floats are refused. Amounts are written as Decimal values.
- Dates are ISO YYYY-MM-DD.

Checks run (inputs and outputs in a temp folder, not the work folder)
- 2 CSV rows exported. The sheet read back as: [date, amount], [2026-10-01, 12.5], [2026-10-02, 7.25], [summary, "2 rows, total 19.75"]. The CLI printed the .xlsx path.
- A float amount raises TypeError. A date of 10/01/2026 raises ValueError. A .csv output path raises ValueError.
